The operational process described for Fashion Forward highlights a significant bottleneck in their warehouse management. The reliance on an outdated First-In-First-Out (FIFO) system creates a physical obstruction where newer stock is buried behind older inventory. This layout necessitates time-consuming reorganization efforts every time recent items are required for shipment, leading to inefficiencies in order fulfillment and increased labor costs. To improve efficiency, the company should consider implementing a more flexible storage system, such as a dynamic slotting strategy or a warehouse management system that tracks item location independently of arrival time, allowing for direct access to any item regardless of when it was stored.
